title: ADHD and Autism: Difference, Not Deficiency — Understanding, Adapting, Empowering
summary: ADHD: inattention, hyperactivity, impulsivity — a brain that works differently, not broken. Autism: differences in communication, behaviour, and sensory processing — a broad spectrum with unique strengths. Early diagnosis + behavioural intervention (ABA/CBT) + school accommodations (extra time, breaks, written instructions) + medication if needed = success. Parents: focus on strengths, seek professional evaluation, collaborate with the school.
try_this: This week: identify 3 strengths your child has (creativity, deep focus, visual memory, empathy) — design a weekly activity that utilises one of them.
reflection_prompts: How can the school support him better?

review_defects.english: differences in communication, behaviour, and sensory processing
review_defects.why: Arabic says 'الحواس' (senses), not 'sensory processing'. The English adds 'processing', slightly shifting the meaning.
Arabic uses 'ابنكم' (your son), which is gender-specific. English uses 'your child', which is gender-neutral, losing the original masculine specificity.
